info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Delivery Services API

params.name: status
params.description: Current status of the delivery service. The status parameters are not case sensitive, you can write them with upper or lower case. This field includes the following statuses as possible values: Ativo, Roteirizado, Realizado, EmAndamento, NaoRealizado

params.name: dateInit
params.description: Initial date of registration of the requested service. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.

params.name: dateEnd
params.description:
End date of registration of the requested service. The date format is `yyyy-mm-dd`.

Make sure that the period of time between `dateInit` and `dateEnd` is not greater than 30 days.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items shown per consultation page. The default is 25
